Wild West Royalty Scapbook : Wild West Days is an annual event, and big doings, in Viroqua, Wisconsin. As with many other events and towns, each year a court of royalty is chosen and coronated to represent and promote at meet and greets, banquets, parades, benefits, fundraisers, coronations and other events. Some community service is included. It is not a beauty contest, nor is it about pageantry. The girls are held to a very high standard. Their grades must be kept up. Anything they do reflects back on the event and/or town they represent. They must conduct themselves in a lady-like fashion. Being on court is considered an honor, and getting there means a full year of madness for the girls and their parents since there are events to attend nearly every weekend. The girls develop an instant kinship, and because of the unique common experience, girls from other courts share a sense of family.   *********** 
To make a long story short, imagine how it felt when our daughter, Grace, was coronated Miss Wild West a short time back! Six girls in total were placed on the 2013 court. She has a first and second attendant. There is also a Junior Miss and her first attendant, and a Little Miss. They are advised by a most remarkable and dedicated couple who give of themselves with selfless devotion. Parents are, and need to be, heavily involved, because amid all the fun, there is also a good deal of work. *************  
This gallery will be ongoing and added to throughout the coming months and is one of the few galleries I have left "open", which is to say that any person, parent, friend or loved one can download any full sized image. Please see "DOWNLOADING UPDATE" below. I am offering these images to all for free so that those involved can keep any images they wish of this amazing year to come. That having been said, our first event of the year was Syttende Mai in Westby, Wisconsin. And so ... it begins.  ***********  SIDE BAR: Note that there some odd crops in this gallery. If you take these images to a lab for printing, be sure to insist that they SCALE THE IMAGE TO FIT THE MEDIA. It is always better to trim extra white off of the print than to end up with a forehead cut off.  **********  DOWNLOADING UPDATE: Please note that if you hover over an image that's featured on the right, you will get a pop up for VIEW SIZE. To download the full size images (best for printing) you should click on the SAVE PHOTO folder icon below ORIGINAL at the bottom of the list. Some folks have been unknowingly downloading much smaller sizes and are having terrible results getting prints. Get the best quality possible ... it's free!
